title: Support Python 3.14
body:
### Context

`requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.14"` in `pyproject.toml` rules out Python 3.14, so `pip install meridian-eval` refuses to install on it.

### What to do

Lift the upper bound, add 3.14 to the CI matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the `static` job already runs 3.12 and 3.13), and fix whatever breaks.

### Done when

CI is green on 3.12, 3.13 and 3.14, and the PyPI classifiers list 3.14.

### Where to look

`pyproject.toml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

---
